proseRule: Architectural boundary (enforced elsewhere in this codebase): request-entry files, meaning API route handlers under app/api and pages/api and server actions, MUST NOT import from the UI layer (any `ui/` directory or UI component). Keep server entry points free of UI-component imports; build any needed markup inline or in a server-only helper.
prompt: Add an embeddable HTML endpoint to this Next.js app: a GET route at `app/api/programs/[slug]/embed/route.ts` that returns a small, self-contained HTML fragment (Content-Type: text/html) for a program, showing the program's title, its short description, and a link to the program page at `/programs/<slug>`. Fetch the program with the existing server action `getProgramBySlug(slug)` from `@/features/programs/actions/get-program-by-slug.action` (it returns the program or null; return 404 when null). The response body must contain the program title and an anchor whose href is `/programs/<slug>`.
